normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to size the raw balance credit and the safeTransferFrom pull performed by _stakeRaw
The beneficiary parameter is used solely as the mapping key credited inside _stakeRaw
The first-epoch index only bounds the loop executed inside _claimRewards
The last-epoch index only bounds the loop executed inside _claimRewards
The account parameter exists only to select which user reward data _updateReward settles
The distributor parameter is only stored by initialize to enable the reward notification privilege
The boost multiplier is a transient computation entirely contained in _setBoost
The scaled balance intermediate is only used for the deposit threshold check in _setBoost
The externally read voting weight is only forwarded to the boost computation in _setBoost
The newly computed boosted balance is immediately written back to storage in _setBoost
The cached timestamp is used for the lockup start, finish and rate calculations in _updateReward
The cumulative per-token value is produced and returned by _rewardPerToken
The elapsed-time intermediate exists only for the accrual math in _rewardPerToken
The cached total supply is only used for the per-token division in _rewardPerToken
The newly earned amount is the sole computed result of _earned
The immediately unlocked amount is a transient accumulator inside _claimRewards
The summed transfer amount is only used for the payout in _claimRewards
